subject: Cross-border transfer clauses, SCCs & signature plan
raw_messages:
From: Sophie Grant <sophie@helios-analytics.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-18 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Initial questions on DPA redlines and cross-border language

Hi Neha / Karthik,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. We reviewed the draft DPA internally and have three items we wanted to surface before legal redlines:

1) Transfers: We need confirmation that the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) will be applied for EU transfers and that you will sign the UK Addendum for UK data. Please confirm where you plan to host the executed SCCs (pdf or Annex).

2) TIA / Supplementary Measures: Under Schrems II we may need a brief transfer impact assessment or at least an outline of the supplementary measures Redwood would apply (encryption, access controls, contractual limits). Can you share a short note?

3) Subprocessors and notification cadence: Attached is our subprocessor questionnaire — please confirm Redwood's current subprocessor list and the cadence for notifications of additions.

We also want to align on signature flow. Our procurement prefers AdobeSign. If Redwood prefers DocuSign, fine — just want to avoid a second round of re-signing.

Attached: Helios_Subprocessors_20260318.xlsx

Looking forward to your responses so our legal team can proceed with redlines.

Best,
Sophie Grant
Senior Counsel, Privacy
Helios Analytics

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@helios-analytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-19 08:26:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial questions on DPA redlines and cross-border language

Sophie — thanks for the clear list. Short answers and a proposed plan below.

1) SCCs / UK addendum: We will execute the EU SCCs and sign the UK Addendum (UK IDTA style) as part of the DPA package. We typically keep a signed PDF on the contract folder and include signed Annexes in the DocuSign/AdobeSign envelope.

2) TIA / Supplementary measures: I attached a one-page note (SCCs_Supplementary-Measures-note.docx) summarizing our baseline measures — encryption at rest/in transit, key management options, egress controls, and contractual restrictions on onward transfers. If Helios would like a fuller TIA, Redwood's privacy team can produce it; timeline ~5 business days after final redlines.

3) Subprocessors: Redwood maintains a live subprocessor list; we push notifcations 30 days before changes for contracted customers. See attached subprocessor sheet for the current roster.

Signature flow: Redwood can accept AdobeSign if Helios prefers — we'll prepare the envelope that way to avoid back-and-forth.

Next steps I propose:
- Redwood legal to incorporate our agreed transfer text into the DPA (I’ve attached my comments in Redlines PDF).
- Helios legal to provide any substantive redlines (we'll aim to turn within 48 hours).
- After final text, we'll send an AdobeSign envelope (one Doc for DPA + SCCs + UK addendum).

Attached: Redwood_DPA_v3_neha_comments.pdf; SCCs_Supplementary-Measures-note.docx

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Legal, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Sophie Grant <sophie@helios-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-20 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial questions on DPA redlines and cross-border language

Sophie / team — quick commercial note from procurement side: Helios asked our procurement team about audit and indemnity items earlier. To keep execution timelines tight, we should avoid open-ended onsite audits or clauses that change our standard breach notification windows.

If Helios needs an expanded audit right, let's track that separately in the SOW or professional services addendum. For the DPA, our standard position is remote audit/attestation and SOC2 reports.

Marissa: please keep an eye on pricing implications if Helios requests data residency guarantees.

Karthik
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Muller <tom.muller@helios-analytics.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Grant <sophie@helios-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-03-21 09:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial questions on DPA redlines and cross-border language

Thanks all. We appreciate the clear plan. Two small asks from Helios product/privacy:

- Retention / logs: could Redwood add a clause clarifying that operational logs containing customer identifiers are retained for up to 90 days by default, with the option to shorten that on request? That helps us meet internal compliance.

- Onsite audit: Helios would like the option for a once-per-year onsite inspection, subject to standard NDA and scope limits. If Redwood prefers not to include that in the DPA, we propose a compromise: include a clause that permits a vendor-led review with an up-to-3-day on-site request, payable by Helios.

If those two items are acceptable at a high level, we can provide markups today and aim to sign next week.

Tom
Head of Security
Helios Analytics

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Muller <tom.muller@helios-analytics.com>, Sophie Grant <sophie@helios-analytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-22 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial questions on DPA redlines and cross-border language

Tom / Sophie — appreciate the quick turnaround. Summary / agreed path: 

• Transfers: Redwood will include the EU SCCs and UK addendum in the final DPA. Signed copies will live in the contract Drive folder and be attached to the signing envelope.

• TIA: Redwood privacy will produce a concise Transfer Impact Assessment that summarizes the risk analysis and the supplementary measures; delivery target is 3 business days after Helios sends final redlines.

• Subprocessors: current roster attached; Redwood provides 30 days notice for additions.

• Retention / logs: we can add a 90-day default operational log retention clause with a mechanism for Helios to request a shorter period via support ticket (we'll flag any feasibility/pricing impacts).

• Onsite audit: Redwood’s standard DPA will note SOC2 + remote attestation as primary audit mechanism. For a once-per-year onsite inspection, we can agree to a limited right subject to scope, NDA, and reasonable cost recovery — we will draft language that permits a paid on-site review with a 30-day notice.

Next steps I will take this afternoon: consolidate agreed language into a final DPA bundle, run legal's quick QA, and prepare an AdobeSign envelope (DPA + SCCs + UK addendum). HubSpot deal will be updated and I’ll include the AdobeSign envelope link.

If Helios sends the markups today, we will prioritize turnaround so we can aim to have an executed DPA by next week.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Legal, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments referenced above: Helios_Subprocessors_20260318.xlsx; Redwood_DPA_v3_neha_comments.pdf; SCCs_Supplementary-Measures-note.docx
